notes:
### New

- An agent can now steer a message into a Codex session's turn in progress, when you ask it to (#68, thanks @xunhe730). `send_message` takes `delivery: steer`; without it the message still waits for the next turn. Only Codex takes a steer, `list_sessions` says which sessions can, and `get_message` reads the answer from the turn the message went into.
- When a message from your iPhone can't reach the agent, the Mac now tells the phone why, and says so right away when Send messages is off (#104). The next iPhone update shows these reasons in plain words; until then the phone shows "Not delivered by the Mac". Send from this computer in Settings → Remote shows the same reasons.

### Fixes

- Steers and automatic sends reach Codex in ChatGPT.app 157 again, which reports its threads in a newer format (thanks @xunhe730).
- `send_message` and `start_session` work again with Codex command-line builds that have no message queue, such as 0.169.0-alpha (#94). Agent HUD now queues the message through the Codex app's own command line.
- Claude Code and Codex can send agent messages again after Agent HUD moved to another folder (#100). At launch, Agent HUD now points their Agent HUD server entry at the copy that is running.
- The HUD no longer shows 0% for a quota window whose reset time has passed (#90). Until the next read, that window sets neither the number, its colour nor its ring.
- The hover panel shows only the agents that screen's HUD shows, as picked in Settings → Display (#85).
- Settings, Statistics and sign-in windows open on the desktop you are on, instead of switching back to the desktop where they were first opened (#99).
- A message's sender line names Grok Bot, Pi and OpenCode instead of calling them Codex (thanks @Alex-Liu-airjelly).
- Settings and Statistics load their text before they first draw (#87, thanks @Ultroncn).
- The release news beside the HUD is wider and sits on a solid background.
